reference.notes:
I've implemented the four functions in `packages/core/src/ticket.ts`, which is the only file I changed. All 226 tests in the package pass, including the visible and hidden ticket-content-check suites. `npm test` with the coverage check also passes, with 100% coverage on `ticket.js`.

- **`normalizeSpecText`** splits the text on CRLF, CR or LF, trims the end of each line, joins the lines with LF and trims the whole result. It does the same thing as the private `normalize` in `packages/jira/src/spec.ts`.
- **`ticketSpecHash`** takes the SHA-256 of `JSON.stringify` of the three normalized fields, using `TextEncoder` and `crypto.subtle`, and returns it as 64 lowercase hex characters. I copied the steps from `pricingSpecHash`, so the output is byte-identical. Nothing is cached between calls.
- **`clampTicketTitle`** cuts the title to 255 UTF-16 code units. If the last code unit is then a high surrogate (`0xD800`–`0xDBFF`), it drops that one unit. This also happens when the title was already short enough, as the spec requires. It doesn't trim whitespace or add an ellipsis.
- **`ticketKey`** returns `jiraKey ?? \`T-${String(number)}\``. An empty or blank `jiraKey` is still returned as the key, and the number is not checked.
